newsitem.title: UK: Jagger and Hall together again after split - paper.
newsitem.headline: Jagger and Hall together again after split - paper.

text.p: Rolling Stones singer Mick Jagger and his wife, Texan model Jerry Hall, were reported on Tuesday to be back together again after she is said to have forgiven his philandering.
"Mick has moved back into the family home. The argument is over and his toothbrush is back in the bathroom," a friend of the famed showbusiness couple told the Daily Telegraph.
"The split is history and everything is rosy in the garden again. This is the divorce that never was," the friend said.
Hall consulted a divorce lawyer after being exasperated by persistent tabloid reports of Jagger being involved with other women.
The paper said the 53-year-old rock star had been staying in a hotel but had now moved back into their London home.

Hall said in a recent interview: "I always hoped that one day he would outgrow these things. You know we always live in hope. There is nothing more humiliating than loving someone so much that you forgive the infidelities."
